Warbonds.Name: Standard Issue
Warbonds.Description: Free for every soldier: real-world rifles, SMGs, shotguns and machine guns that fit right next to the classic arsenal.

Warbonds.Name: Daily Armory
Warbonds.Description: Free for everyone. Eight random weapons from all the battle passes, new every day at midnight. You don't need their battle pass or its pages, but they cost twice as much.

Warbonds.Name: Supply Depot
Warbonds.Description: Every consumable of the game: boosters, tools, room host options and supplies you can buy again and again. Pick how many you want. Damage Display, Killer Display, Minimap Improvement, Retry, Round Retry and Advanced Body Armor are yours for good, free.

Warbonds.Name: Korean 707 Commando
Warbonds.Description: Gear up like the ROK Army's 707th Special Mission Group, with Korean-made K-series weapons.

Warbonds.Name: Chinese Devils
Warbonds.Description: China's elite counter-terror unit and its QBZ-family rifles, machine guns and shotguns.

Warbonds.Name: Asian Red Army
Warbonds.Description: An insurgent cell armed with Kalashnikovs and Eastern Bloc firepower.

Warbonds.Name: Vigilante Corps
Warbonds.Description: Irish paramilitaries with Thompsons, Armalites, a .50 calibre rifle and a general-purpose machine gun.

Warbonds.Name: Red Beret Condottiere
Warbonds.Description: Italian mercenaries armed with Franchi combat shotguns and the Beretta ARX-160.

Warbonds.Name: Japanese SAT
Warbonds.Description: Japan's police Special Assault Team: compact SMGs, a precision rifle and a duty pistol.

Warbonds.Name: Angel vs Devil
Warbonds.Description: Criss and Yuri, two agents dressed as an angel and a devil, with an ether rifle and a pair of infernal swords.

Warbonds.Name: Double Agent
Warbonds.Description: Ji Yoon Choi and Ritsuka work both sides. They carry twin Uzis and a gunslinger's pair of Berettas.

Warbonds.Name: Master of Disguise
Warbonds.Description: Mei and Erica blend into any crowd. Their throwing knives come in sets of one, two and three.

Warbonds.Name: Exorcism Legends
Warbonds.Description: Fernando and Blair hunt what hides in the dark, with refined holy water and a sword of the Divine Order.

Warbonds.Name: Marine Force
Warbonds.Description: Enzo and Lucia of the marine corps, Lucia's special operations kit, and weapons made for the water.

Warbonds.Name: Double Casual
Warbonds.Description: Natasha in casual clothes and Jennifer in uniform, off duty but never unarmed.

Warbonds.Name: Pirate Union
Warbonds.Description: Raven and Michaela sail under one flag, with a flintlock, a shark-jawed shotgun and Michaela's captain outfit.

Warbonds.Name: Soccer Uniforms
Warbonds.Description: Max Thacker, the Asian Red Army, Ji Yoon Choi and Yuri in their soccer kits.

Warbonds.Name: Limited Editions
Warbonds.Description: The limited edition looks of Michaela, Ji Yoon Choi, Yuri and Alice.

Warbonds.Name: Vietnamese Classes
Warbonds.Description: Hari and Kyrix, the Vietnamese classes, with a sawed-off M79, an M16A1 and a nata knife for the jungle.

Warbonds.Name: Taiwanese Thunder Squad
Warbonds.Description: Taiwan's Thunder Squad and its own VICTORY machine gun.

Warbonds.Name: Nat'l Lib. Campaign
Warbonds.Description: A separatist cell with a customised AK-47 and a Sterling submachine gun with a bayonet.

Warbonds.Name: Idol Stage
Warbonds.Description: Ling Ling and both Alices on stage, with the Lightning instruments: guitar, violin, camera, rainbow and water guns.

Warbonds.Name: Street Fighters
Warbonds.Description: Isabella the boxer, Spade and the SAF scout, with a Power Falcon and a Python Desperado.

Warbonds.Name: Dr. Han's Lab
Warbonds.Description: Dr. Han and Jenny, with a grenade launcher and a sniper rifle that fires grenades too.

Warbonds.Name: Weekend Off
Warbonds.Description: Alin and Dominique on their day off, with a firework launcher and a slingshot.

Warbonds.Name: Transcendence
Warbonds.Description: Balrog and Skull weapons forged for the front line.

Warbonds.Name: Thanatos Protocol
Warbonds.Description: The full Thanatos series, from sidearm to scythe.

Warbonds.Name: Winter Holidays
Warbonds.Description: Seasonal gear from the Christmas events.

Warbonds.Name: Janus Arsenal
Warbonds.Description: Transforming JANUS weapons that switch to a devastating second mode.

Warbonds.Name: Hunter-Killer
Warbonds.Description: The X-series: precision hardware built to track and finish the target.

Warbonds.Name: Vulcanus Forge
Warbonds.Description: Heat-forged VULCANUS weapons with a burning second mode.

Warbonds.Name: Halloween Night
Warbonds.Description: Haunted weapons and costumes from the Halloween event.

Warbonds.Name: Summer Splash
Warbonds.Description: Beach-ready Splash weapons and summer outfits.

Warbonds.Name: Elegant Frontier
Warbonds.Description: Engraved Wild West classics for sheriffs and outlaws.

Warbonds.Name: Apocalypse
Warbonds.Description: Scavenged, rebuilt and overkill: everything a survivor needs when the world has ended.

Warbonds.Name: Cyberpunk
Warbonds.Description: Neon, plasma and lasers from the edge of tomorrow's war.

Warbonds.Name: Gold Rush
Warbonds.Description: Every gold-plated edition in the armoury. Pure prestige, at a premium.

Warbonds.Name: Eastern Legends
Warbonds.Description: Dragons, tigers and ancient blades: legendary arms and warriors from the East.
